topic.title: MS Writing Style Guide Vale Rules

body.p: An extra add-on is available that contributes a set of rules based on the Microsoft Writing Style Guide to the Terminology Checker. It contains a Vale-compatible () implementation of the MS Writing Style Guide () as provided by the errata-ai open-source project (). Note that this project is neither maintained nor endorsed by Microsoft.
To install these rules, use the manual add-on install procedure and select MS Writing Style Guide Vale Rules for the add-on to install.
